description.text: At the opening instant, the complete supplied frame holds: a black sports car with a carbon fibre body rests on an empty showroom floor, its panels faintly lit while the surrounding space falls away into deep shadow. The floor is broad and uncluttered, with no other vehicle or figure in view. The car sits low and still, its dark bodywork gathering thin reflections. Then its nose eases forward from the standstill, the whole vehicle beginning a slow roll out of the darkness. Faint light slides along the hood, roof and flanks as the car advances, while the showroom remains otherwise empty and motionless. The movement is smooth and gradual, keeping the car's shape readable as the shadow starts to release it.
